_comment: The routing oracle from docs/specs/skill-activation.md as data. A test keeps it equal to the spec's table.

implement.situation: Feature, fix, refactor or migration, including right after plan approval

prepare.situation: Technical preparation without implementing, including Architecture Pack preparation

resume.situation: Resume of task state, backlog item, or intended-change idea

tdd.situation: Tests-first request, project TDD rule, or workflow-selected TDD check

debug_diagnose.situation: Failure with an unknown cause, diagnosis only

debug_fix.situation: Failure with an unknown cause, fix authorized

ci_known.situation: CI fix or review comment with a known cause

create_pr.situation: "create pr" with changes that never went through workflow

skill_change.situation: Change to `skills/**`, contracts or skill evals in this repository

skill_standalone.situation: Create or update a standalone skill outside this repository's delivery

skill_review_fix.situation: Review and fix a skill in this repository

skill_diff_review.situation: Formal review of a delivered diff that touches skills

skill_upstream.situation: Check of registered upstream skill guidance

review.situation: Review of code, spec, plan, tests, documents, Jira ticket or refinement material

verify.situation: Selecting checks or judging evidence, as its own request

ci_audit.situation: Weak, slow or false-passing CI and tests

security_change.situation: Change touching auth, external input, secrets, sensitive data, persistence, network or shell calls, dependencies or config, or external integrations

security_audit.situation: Threat model, vulnerability audit, dependency audit or attack-surface analysis

clarify.situation: Request whose intent is still unresolved after inspection

none.situation: Narrow question, or running an existing test command
